contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine, (Reece period 17). Reverse shows Victory standing left on prow. Reverse legend: - . Mint is uncertain but this coin is copying a coin minted in Lyon, AD c.330-340. See RIC VII, p.138, c.f.246. Obverse legend reads [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Obverse shows helmeted bust left. Reverse fields and exergue read: - / //PLG. Condition is…
